prompt: In a MULTI/EXEC block, the second command fails at runtime with WRONGTYPE. What does Redis do?
explanation: Redis transactions have no rollback: commands queued successfully all execute when EXEC arrives, and a runtime error in one command affects only that command. Earlier results stand and later commands still run — the application must interpret the per-command results.

options.text: EXEC still runs every queued command; the failing one reports an error and the rest apply normally
EXEC aborts and undoes the commands that already ran
Redis skips the failing command and silently rolls the others back
The transaction enters a retry loop until every command succeeds
